mapper.select: SELECT fc.category_code AS categoryCode, fc.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(f.facility_id) AS count FROM facility f INNER JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.status = 1 GROUP BY fc.category_code, fc.category_name, fc.sort_order ORDER BY fc.sort_order

SELECT score_level AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM ( SELECT community_id, score_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY community_id ORDER BY analyze_time DESC) AS rn FROM accessibility_score ) t WHERE rn = 1 AND score_level IS NOT NULL GROUP BY score_level

SELECT CASE WHEN price < 5000 THEN '5000以下' WHEN price < 8000 THEN '5000-8000' WHEN price < 10000 THEN '8000-10000' WHEN price < 15000 THEN '10000-15000' ELSE '15000以上' END AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM community WHERE price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN price < 5000 THEN '5000以下' WHEN price < 8000 THEN '5000-8000' WHEN price < 10000 THEN '8000-10000' WHEN price < 15000 THEN '10000-15000' ELSE '15000以上' END ORDER BY MIN(price)

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) f.facility_id AS facilityId, f.facility_name AS name, fc.category_name AS categoryName, f.avg_score AS score FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND f.avg_score > 0 ORDER BY f.avg_score DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM facility WHERE status = 1) AS facilityTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community) AS communityTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM [evaluation]) AS evaluationTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM [evaluation] WHERE status = 1) AS passEvalTotal, (SELECT ISNULL(AVG(price), 0) FROM community WHERE price IS NOT NULL) AS avgPrice, (SELECT ISNULL(AVG(avg_score), 0) FROM community) AS avgCommunityScore, (SELECT ISNULL(AVG(avg_score), 0) FROM facility WHERE status = 1) AS avgFacilityScore, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM district) AS districtTotal

DECLARE @minLng FLOAT = #{minLng}; DECLARE @maxLng FLOAT = #{maxLng}; DECLARE @minLat FLOAT = #{minLat}; DECLARE @maxLat FLOAT = #{maxLat}; DECLARE @poly GEOGRAPHY = geography::STPolyFromText( 'POLYGON((' + CAST(@minLng AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + CAST(@minLat AS VARCHAR(20)) + ',' + CAST(@maxLng AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + CAST(@minLat AS VARCHAR(20)) + ',' + CAST(@maxLng AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + CAST(@maxLat AS VARCHAR(20)) + ',' + CAST(@minLng AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + CAST(@maxLat AS VARCHAR(20)) + ',' + CAST(@minLng AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + CAST(@minLat AS VARCHAR(20)) + '))', 4326); SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM facility WHERE status = 1 AND longitude BETWEEN @minLng AND @maxLng AND latitude BETWEEN @minLat AND @maxLat) AS facilityCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community WHERE longitude BETWEEN @minLng AND @maxLng AND latitude BETWEEN @minLat AND @maxLat) AS communityCount, (SELECT ISNULL(AVG(price), 0) FROM community WHERE longitude BETWEEN @minLng AND @maxLng AND latitude BETWEEN @minLat AND @maxLat AND price IS NOT NULL) AS avgPrice, (SELECT ISNULL(AVG(avg_score), 0) FROM community WHERE longitude BETWEEN @minLng AND @maxLng AND latitude BETWEEN @minLat AND @maxLat) AS avgScore, @poly.STArea() / 1000000.0 AS areaKm2, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM facility WHERE status = 1 AND longitude BETWEEN @minLng AND @maxLng AND latitude BETWEEN @minLat AND @maxLat) / NULLIF(@poly.STArea() / 1000000.0, 0) AS facilityDensityPerKm2
